name: multi14-italy
description: 14-day multi-city trip with a fixed allocation of days to cities (Milan 3, Venice 3, Florence 4, Rome 4); a move day leaves the previous city at 09:00 and starts at the new city's centre when the fixed drive ends.
travel_rule: estimated: min(walk 4.5 km/h, local 30 km/h + 12 min, inter-city 80 km/h + 20 min) on straight-line distance x 1.30 (1.25 inter-city)
